Hannah / team — quick legal read after reviewing ACME_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf. Summary below (short + actionable):

1) Signature authority: Redwood can accept the Order Form signed by an "Authorized Representative". We prefer the signer be named and titled on the signature block, but the phrase "Authorized Representative" with printed name/title beneath is acceptable for our records. No CEO-level requirement.

2) Electronic signature: DocuSign is acceptable. If Acme elects to use Ariba-native signing, we need the portal signature evidence to include the signer name and an electronic signature stamp. Language stating "electronically signed by [name]" is sufficient. Either method is fine for downstream legal/archival purposes.

3) Redlines: Most edits are operational (delivery SLA, billing address) and are acceptable. One redline we want to flag for negotiation in the MSA: the indemnity carve-out on p.4. That clause needs to stay limited to third-party IP claims; I've added a short markup in the attached PDF.

4) Required vendor profile fields for enrollment (please populate exactly as listed):
- Legal Entity Name
- DBA (if applicable)
- Tax ID / EIN
- Remit-to address (street, city, state, postal)
- Signer name + title + email
- W-9 (or local tax form)

Please attach the updated OF and W-9 to the Ariba registration so Ops can validate. Mateo — if you want, I can sign off on the redline once Ops confirms field mapping.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference

Thanks Laura — that guidance helps. Attaching portal-field-mapping.xlsx with the Ariba attribute names and our expected values for each. High-level notes: 

- We can accept DocuSign-signed Order Forms. If we receive DocuSign we will still register the vendor in Ariba and accept POs via EDI. No technical blocking there.
- Required Ariba field mapping (column names in the attached sheet): LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME -> "Legal Entity Name", TAX_ID -> "EIN/Tax ID", SIGNER_NAME -> "Signer Name", SIGNER_TITLE -> "Signer Title", SIGNER_EMAIL -> "Signer Email", REMIT_ADDRESS -> separated fields for street/city/state/zip.
- PO acknowledgement window: set to 48 hours by default. If Acme requires immediate auto-ack on EDI we can change to 24h with a short SLA amendment.
- EDI/ACK: we support 997/855 message flows; please confirm EDI partner details and SFTP endpoint.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Sarah — populate the Ariba registration with the exact values listed in the sheet and attach the signed Order Form + W-9.
2) Redwood Ops (me) to validate the profile and flip the vendor to "Active".
3) Legal (Laura) to give final sign-off on the redline we marked in the PDF; once signed we'll confirm acceptance and start processing POs.

Tentative MAP: enroll by 2026-08-07, legal sign-off by 2026-08-09, vendor Active by 2026-08-10, first PO processing week of 2026-08-10. If that timeline looks tight, flag now and we'll adjust.

Attachments: portal-field-mapping.xlsx

Best,
